section: 1. Where did you live before MDS, and what is one thing you miss about it?
text:
1. Where did you live before MDS, and what is one thing you miss about it?
Jared: I lived in Vancouver before MDS, so don’t have much to miss. Ethan: I lived in Starkville, MS for the past five years and the few things I missed about it are my friends and the short commuting trip. Hans: I was in China and I miss the dim sum breakfast a lot. Rshan: I was living in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and I miss Enjera my favorite food.

text:
4. What is one thing you want to be able to do by the end of the program?
Jared: I want to be able to take any data set and make it usable. Ethan: I would like to be capable of utilizing the latest AI tools and build my own AI models. Hans: Finish and understand the entire DA pipeline, work on research projects on my own. Rshan: I want to be a professional data sceince.
